notes.title: New windows build 1.2.0
notes.content:
New build is now available for windows. We're still working on getting the last few glitches sorted on Mac and Linux. We hope to get those out in the next week or so.

Thanks for all the feedback, we really appreciate it. We've fixed some annoying little bugs and can now announce that ALL THE ACHIEVEMENTS WORK (we think). Apologies for that. A breakdown of what's fixed is at the bottom.

We're working on the xbox port now and we'll be putting in any new features we add for it. More news on that later.

Thanks again and please get in touch if you find any problems or want to give us some feedback. We hope you're having as much fun playing the game as we had making it.



1.2.0
Achievement for beating Cat Boss
Achievement for beating Last Boss
Achievement display after Last Boss
UI button sometimes didn't activate on the player died screen
Spawners could stop spawning and make finishing levels take a long time
Scrap could get destroyed and cause stalls
